properties.description: Test pipeline to check Python version on self-hosted IR

scripts.text:
import sys
import os
import platform
import tempfile

print("=== Python Version Check ===")
print(f"Python Version: {sys.version}")
print(f"Python Executable: {sys.executable}")
print(f"Platform: {platform.platform()}")
print(f"Architecture: {platform.architecture()}")

# Check if we can create temp folders
try:
    temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="adf_test_")
    print(f"Temp folder creation: SUCCESS ({temp_dir})")
    os.rmdir(temp_dir)
    print("Temp folder cleanup: SUCCESS")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Temp folder test: FAILED - {e}")

# Check for required modules
modules_to_check = ['zipfile', 'hashlib', 'json', 'os', 'shutil']
print("\n=== Required Modules ===")
for module in modules_to_check:
    try:
        __import__(module)
        print(f"{module}: AVAILABLE")
    except ImportError:
        print(f"{module}: NOT AVAILABLE")

# Check for azure-storage-blob (optional but useful)
try:
    __import__('azure.storage.blob')
    print("azure-storage-blob: AVAILABLE")
except ImportError:
    print("azure-storage-blob: NOT AVAILABLE (can be installed if needed)")

print("=== Test Complete ===")
